multi_pack_index_effect.note: Same harness and fixture before and after adding a periodic multi-pack-index refresh during clone replay. At depth 1000 the cost per head fell from 22.47 to 12.40 ms and the ratio over git from 19.73x to 10.75x. Growth resumes by depth 10^4, where the index itself spans 10^4 packs; consolidation is the mitigation that keeps depth bounded in the first place.

provenance_caveat: Per-rep samples and server ciphertext byte counts for this run were written inside the work directory and lost when the cleanup trap fired after the optional consolidation step failed. The medians here are the harness's own per-checkpoint output, which is measured, but a re-run is required before these cells carry full dispersion. Every clone in the run passed the tree-hash equality check against the plain-git arm.
notes: Measured only. The previous AEAD-rate model and its synthesized dispersion were removed rather than relabelled.
Clone is the operation that does not amortize: a blind host cannot repack, so cost tracks head count rather than bytes.
